title: Polycomb protein binding and looping mediated by Polycomb Response Elements in the ON transcriptional state
authors: J. Lesley Brown; Liangliang Zhang; Pedro P Rocha; Judith A. Kassis; Ming-an Sun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究果蝇Polycomb蛋白在ON转录状态下与PRE元件的结合及染色质环化，涉及蛋白-DNA结合但无AI/物理模拟方法，且非TF-DNA体系，仅部分相关。
abstract: Polycomb group proteins (PcG) mediate epigenetic silencing of important developmental genes and other targets. In Drosophila, canonical PcG-target genes contain Polycomb Response Elements (PREs) that recruit PcG protein complexes including PRC2 that tri- methylates H3K27 forming large H3K27me3 domains. In the OFF transcriptional state, PREs loop with each other and this looping strengthens silencing. Here we address the question of what PcG proteins bind to PREs when canonical PcG target genes are expressed, and whether PREs loop when these genes are ON. Our data show that the answer to this question is PRE-specific but general conclusions can be made. First, within a PcG-target gene, some regulatory DNA can remain covered with H3K27me3 and PcG proteins remain bound to PREs in these regions. Second, when PREs are within H3K27ac domains, PcG- binding decreases, however, this depends on the protein and PRE. The DNA binding protein GAF, and the PcG protein Ph remain at PREs even when other PcG proteins are greatly depleted. In the ON state, PREs can still loop with each other, but also form loops with presumptive enhancers. These data support the model that, in addition to their role in PcG silencing, PREs can act as “promoter-tethering elements” mediating interactions between promoter proximal PREs and distant enhancers.
abstract_zh: Polycomb group 蛋白（PcG）介导重要发育基因及其他靶标的表观遗传沉默。在果蝇中，经典 PcG 靶基因包含 Polycomb 响应元件（PREs），这些元件招募包括 PRC2 在内的 PcG 蛋白复合物，PRC2 对 H3K27 进行三甲基化，形成大的 H3K27me3 结构域。在转录关闭状态下，PREs 相互成环，这种成环作用增强了沉默效应。在此，我们探讨了当经典 PcG 靶基因表达时，哪些 PcG 蛋白结合到 PREs，以及这些基因处于开启状态时 PREs 是否成环。我们的数据表明，这一问题的答案是 PRE 特异性的，但可以得出一般性结论。首先，在 PcG 靶基因内部，某些调控 DNA 可保持被 H3K27me3 覆盖，且 PcG 蛋白仍结合于这些区域的 PREs。其次，当 PREs 位于 H3K27ac 结构域内时，PcG 结合减少，但这取决于具体蛋白和 PRE。DNA 结合蛋白 GAF 和 PcG 蛋白 Ph 即使在其他 PcG 蛋白大幅减少时仍保留在 PREs 上。在开启状态下，PREs 仍可相互成环，但也与推定增强子形成环状结构。这些数据支持一个模型，即 PREs 除了在 PcG 沉默中发挥作用外，还可作为“启动子锚定元件”，介导启动子近端 PREs 与远端增强子之间的相互作用。
